plain_description.what: Rebuilds the tree discovered without declared categories, with the bar a split must clear to be accepted lowered from 2.0 to 1.5 and to 1.0. It reports leaves, the biggest leaf, purity and how many splits pass the significance certificate. No judge calls.
plain_description.why: One big leaf (549 engineering/chemistry/physics questions) refused every split, and the question was whether a looser bar finds real structure or just makes more leaves.
plain_description.information: If new splits pass the certificate, the bar was too strict. If they don't, the bar is fine and the extra leaves are noise. Result: exploratory only. A bar of 1.5 splits the big leaf and adds 6 leaves, one certified split (three of the four new splits look like noise) and +0.8 points of purity. A bar of 1.0 adds nothing more. The original tree (bar 2.0) stays the tree of record.
